data.name: Mhod
data.gender_notes: Mhod is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mhod is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'manas' which means mind. This name signifies the one who is the lord of the mind or the master of one's thoughts. It is a spiritual name with deep significance in Hindu mythology. The name Mhod carries the meaning “Lord of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mhod usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who controls the mind and thoughts
data.etymology: Mhod belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mhod total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
